name: HEVC 1080p
purpose: ONE 1080p HEVC file serving BOTH a customer download and the Vimeo ingest. RULED 2026-08-23: separate rates for the two purposes are not worth carrying. At 3.5 Mbps it matched H.264 at 5.0 on five of six clips, and it is roughly a third smaller than the old mezzanine - a direct saving against Vimeo storage.
device_caveat: Apple devices from ~2017 and Android play HEVC natively. Windows does NOT ship the decoder - the free VLC player is the remedy, and the portal must say so explicitly rather than gesture at 'some devices'.

measured.rate: 3.5 Mbps. HEVC's advantage GROWS with a tighter budget and harder material - 0.03 VMAF points at the easy end, 3.51 at the hard end.
measured.preset_choice: medium, changed from faster on 2026-08-23. faster was chosen when this file existed only to be re-encoded by Vimeo and its quality did not need to be kept. It is now a customer download. Measured 2026-08-18: faster is 1.67x quicker and 17% smaller, and that 17% is quality not kept.
measured.full_length_baseline: Run 40, 2026-08-23, 99.3 min source: 4.40 Mbps, 3.05 GB, 2.31x realtime under the OLD crf-targeted preset at faster. The ladder rate of 3.5 gives ~2.04 GB.

rate_control: TARGET RATE. rate_kbps is the average bitrate; maxrate and bufsize bound the peak. crf remains as a fallback for any rung without a rate_kbps.

rules.never_upscale: Skip any rung STRICTLY ABOVE source height.
rules.apple_playback: hvc1 tag is REQUIRED. Without it a technically valid HEVC MP4 will not play on Apple devices.
rules.rung_is_derived: RULED 2026-08-25. The 1080p HEVC rate is reduced per film so the file stays under 4 GiB, capped at 3500 and REFUSED below 2500 kbps - past about 205 minutes. Before this, HEVC ran at a FIXED 3500 and crossed 4 GiB past ~152 min, while the H.264 rung was being refused for exceeding the same ceiling. Both rungs now make the same promise: NO FILE EXCEEDS 4 GiB.

rung_provenance.derived: 720p and below are DERIVED, NOT MEASURED, and carry no target rate. They exist for a possible 2027 multi-rung HEVC ladder and are tagged provisional in the editor. 240p removed 2026-08-23.
rung_provenance.status: PROVISIONAL. Measure before any HEVC ladder below 1080p is used in production.
